title: Turkish-Style Lettuce Wraps
description: A vegan twist on traditional Turkish street food, using crispy lettuce leaves as wraps.

ingredients.name: Airy Feta Alternative
ingredients.notes: made from tofu or cashew cream

instructions: Cut the iceberg lettuce into large leaves.
Toast the Turkish bread and crumble it into small pieces.
Mix the Cig Kofte mix with the Airy Feta Alternative and Turkish Spice Blend.
Scoop a small amount of the mix onto each lettuce leaf.
Top with toasted bread crumbs and a sprinkle of lettuce.
Garnish with a fresh iceberg lettuce leaf and serve immediately.
